edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The proposed purchase price for the Shares is USD 13,500,000, payable by Buyer to Seller at Closing in cash by wire transfer of immediately available funds. This amount is a proposal for discussion and is not agreed unless and until the parties execute this Agreement with this provision in final form. No adjustment shall apply except as expressly set forth in a writing signed by both parties.
edits.name: Purchase price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur remotely through exchange of executed documents and funds within thirty days after execution of this Agreement, or on another date agreed in writing by the parties. At Closing, Seller shall deliver (a) certificates representing the Shares, duly endorsed for transfer or accompanied by duly executed stock powers, (b) customary resignations, effective as of Closing, of the Company's directors and officers requested by Buyer, (c) a certificate of Seller confirming that its representations and warranties are true in all material respects as of Closing (subject to any applicable materiality qualifiers and written disclosures delivered before Closing), and (d) such customary transfer instruments and other documents reasonably necessary to transfer the Shares. Buyer shall deliver the purchase price in accordance with Section 1 and a counterpart to each closing document to which it is a party. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to deliver the documents and take the actions reasonably necessary to consummate the transaction at Closing.
edits.name: Closing and deliverables

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. (a) Subject to the limitations and procedures in this Section, Seller shall indemnify Buyer for direct, actual losses, damages, liabilities, judgments, and reasonable out-of-pocket costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) to the extent arising from (i) a breach of Seller's representations and warranties in this Agreement, (ii) a breach of Seller's covenants or obligations in this Agreement, or (iii) undisclosed liabilities of the Company existing as of Closing. Buyer shall give Seller reasonably prompt written notice describing the claim in reasonable detail; delay in notice shall relieve Seller of liability only to the extent materially prejudiced by the delay. Seller may assume the defense of a third-party claim with counsel reasonably acceptable to Buyer, and Buyer may participate at its own expense. No settlement imposing non-monetary relief or an admission of liability on Buyer may be made without Buyer's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld. (b) Claims for breach of representations and warranties must be noticed within twelve months after Closing; claims for breach of covenants survive until twelve months after the applicable covenant is to be performed. Claims noticed before expiration survive until finally resolved. Claims for breach of fundamental representations concerning Seller's authority, title to the Shares, and capitalization survive until the expiration of the applicable statute of limitations. (c) Except for claims arising from fraud or breach of covenants to be performed after Closing, Seller's aggregate liability under this Section shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the purchase price actually paid at Closing. The cap shall not apply to liability for fraud or breach of the fundamental representations identified in subsection (b), for which Seller's aggregate liability shall not exceed the purchase price actually paid at Closing. Buyer may recover under subsection (a) for representation and warranty claims only to the extent aggregate covered losses exceed one percent (1%) of the purchase price actually paid at Closing, in which case Buyer may recover the excess from the first dollar. (d) Neither party shall be liable under this Section for consequential, special, punitive, or exemplary damages, except to the extent payable to a third party in a claim otherwise covered by this Section. (e) Following Closing, the indemnification remedies expressly provided in this Section shall be the parties' exclusive remedies for claims arising out of this Agreement or the transaction, except for claims based on fraud and claims for equitable relief to enforce post-Closing covenants. No party may recover more than once for the same loss.
edits.name: Indemnity
